verdict.rationale: AMD's docs claim ROCm is 'primarily open-source,' giving users freedom to inspect and customize the software stack that runs on the RX 9070 XT, but this refers to the accompanying software ecosystem rather than the GPU hardware/firmware itself, and no explicit repository, license name, or independent corroboration is provided. missing for 10: actual open-source license/repo citation for drivers or firmware, independent confirmation of source availability, clarity on what parts of the stack (vs. proprietary firmware) are truly open.
